import bpy,json
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['harbor_craft']
ns['export_asset']()
for collection,filename in [('Boat_Workshop','fleet_boat_mcp.glb'),('Pier_Working','pier_working_mcp.glb'),('Harbor_Arrival_Landing','harbor_landing_mcp.glb')]:
    c=bpy.data.collections[collection]
    state=(c.hide_viewport,c.hide_render)
    c.hide_viewport=False;c.hide_render=False
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    object_state=[]
    for o in c.objects:
        object_state.append((o,o.hide_get(),o.hide_render))
        o.hide_set(False);o.hide_render=False;o.select_set(True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=next(o for o in c.objects if o.type=='MESH')
    bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(ns['root']/'assets'/filename),export_format='GLB',use_selection=True,
        export_texcoords=True,export_normals=True,export_tangents=True,export_vertex_color='NONE',
        export_materials='EXPORT',export_image_format='AUTO',export_apply=True,export_yup=True,export_animations=False)
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    for o,hidden,render in object_state:o.hide_set(hidden);o.hide_render=render
    c.hide_viewport,c.hide_render=state
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('SURFACE_ASSETS_EXPORTED_4')
